DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 以前のご相談に関係するお話でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this related to your previous consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。知人が私の話をネットに書きました。私が言っていない部分まであるので、どう相談したらよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人公開文が自己相談に不存在部分を追加し相談したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. An acquaintance posted my story online. Some parts are things I never said, so I would like advice on how to discuss this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that an acquaintance added things you never said to a published account of your own consultation, and that you want advice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 公開されている内容を、確認できる形でお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the published content in a form we can check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この画面です。私の名前はありませんが、場所と日付から私のことだと思われるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面を示し匿名だが場所日付で自分推測の可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is on this screen. My name is not there, but the place and date might make people think it is about me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the screen and explain that, although unnamed, you might be identified from the place and date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人が確認した内容と、推測されることを分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask separately about what you have personally confirmed and what is speculation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。私が前に話したことと、知人が付け足した文章をそれぞれ示したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人申告と知人加筆を区別して提示希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I would like to show separately what I previously said and the text my acquaintance added.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to present your own account and the acquaintance's additions separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 投稿した方へ、ご自身から連絡されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you contacted the person who posted it yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。怒って同じように相手の情報を公開する前に、相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未連絡で報復的相手情報公開前に相談に来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I came for advice before getting angry and publishing their information in the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not contacted them and came for advice before retaliating by publishing their information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 経緯とご希望を伺い、相談できる範囲をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask about the background and your wishes, then explain what advice we can offer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。投稿が私の正式な説明だと思われないよう、まず違う部分を伝えます。対応は案内を聞いてから考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 投稿を自己正式説明とせず相違を伝え案内後に対応を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. First I will explain the differences so the post is not taken as my official account. I will consider my response after hearing your guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the differences so the post is not treated as your official account, and say you will consider your response after the guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、経緯をお聞きします。ご相談ありがとうございます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us hear what happened. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛先の字について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the writing in the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鉛筆で書きましたが、かばんの中でこすれて薄くなりました。このままでは読みづらいので直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鉛筆宛名が鞄摩擦で薄れ読みやすく訂正したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote it in pencil, but it rubbed against things in my bag and became faint. It is hard to read like this, so I want to correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the penciled address became faint from rubbing in your bag and you want to correct it for readability. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先を確認できる元の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the original information to check the address against?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持っています。薄くなった字をなぞる前に、元の住所を見て書き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元住所保持し消え字推測なぞりでなく原情報照合を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Before tracing the faint writing, I would like to look at the original address and rewrite it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have the original address and want to check it rather than guess and trace the faded characters. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封筒全体が読みやすくなるよう、記入方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain how to write it so the whole envelope is easy to read.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。数字の一部が消えただけで、行き先が変わったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛先変更でなく数字一部消失と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Only some of the numbers have faded; the destination has not changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clarify that some digits have faded and the destination has not changed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き直した後に、全体の宛先をご自身でもお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: After rewriting it, please also check the complete address yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。文字を重ねてさらに読みにくくするなら、新しい封筒を用意することも考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重ね書きで判読悪化なら新封筒を検討すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If writing over it would make it even harder to read, I will consider using a new envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will consider a new envelope if overwriting would worsen readability. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 包装の状態と送料も、準備後に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once it is ready, let us also check the packaging and postage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日はまず記入を整え、住所の数字と名前を照合します。読める状態にしてから発送を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 数字氏名照合し判読と包装を整えてから差出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. Today I will first tidy up the writing and check the address numbers and name. I will ask to send it once it is legible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the numbers and name and make the writing and packaging ready before sending it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、宛先の記入をご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let me explain how to write the address. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日のご相談の前に、何かございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything before today's consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前に説明していただいて助かったので、菓子を持ってきました。皆さんで食べてもらえたらと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前回銀行案内への感謝で職員用菓子を持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Your explanation last time helped me, so I brought some sweets. I thought everyone could share them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought sweets for the staff to thank them for the bank guidance last time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お気持ちはありがとうございます。ただ、こちらの窓口ではお受け取りできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for the thought. However, we cannot accept them at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでしたか。少しなら受け取れると考えていましたが、このまま持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口の受領不可を理解し量で例外とせず持帰ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I thought a small amount might be acceptable, but I will take them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand that the counter cannot accept them, without treating a small quantity as an exception, and say you will take them home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご理解ありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you for understanding. What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前に案内された書類を用意しました。お礼を渡すことで、手続きが早くなると思っているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内書類準備済で贈物による優先対応を望まないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have prepared the documents you told me about last time. I do not think giving a thank-you gift will make the procedure faster.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have prepared the requested documents and do not want preferential treatment in return for a gift. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本日は、いつもどおり書類を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Today we will check the documents and guide you as usual.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。感謝は言葉で伝えます。ここに置いて帰ると困らせるので、菓子はかばんへ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 言葉で感謝し置去りせず菓子を収納すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will express my thanks in words. Leaving the sweets here would cause trouble, so I will put them back in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will thank them verbally and put the sweets away instead of leaving them behind. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。必要な書類をお見せいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Could you show me the required documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらです。菓子と書類を別にしまいました。前の説明のおかげで準備できたと、改めてお礼を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 菓子と書類を分け前説明が準備に役立ったと謝意を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here they are. I put the sweets and documents away separately. I would like to thank you again because your previous explanation helped me prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you kept the sweets separate from the documents and express thanks for the earlier explanation that helped you prepare. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備いただきありがとうございます。それでは、書類を確認します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for preparing them. Let me check the documents. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの果物の会計について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about paying for this fruit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。重さで値段が決まるようですが、皮をむいてから量るのですか。食べる部分だけかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 量売果物を剥いた可食部のみ測るか販売単位を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The price seems to depend on weight, but do you weigh it after peeling it? I thought it might be just the edible part.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether fruit sold by weight is weighed only after peeling, and clarify the unit of sale. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この果物は、皮をむかずに量って販売します。百グラム当たりの価格は、こちらに表示しています。まだ皮はむいていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We sell this fruit weighed with the peel on. The price per 100 grams is shown here. You have not peeled it yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、そのままです。百グラム当たりの値段なのですね。一個の値段だと思いかけたので、単位が分かってよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未剥皮状態を示し百グラム単価と個数単価の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, it is still as it was. So that is the price per 100 grams. I nearly thought it was the price for one piece, so I am glad I understand the unit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate it is unpeeled and confirm the difference between a price per 100 grams and a price per piece. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでは、売り場の表示と商品の状態を確認してからお会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here we check the display and the condition of the item before taking payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。まだ自分で食べたりむいたりせず、そのまま持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未会計の試食剥皮をせず原状態で持参すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I will bring it as it is, without eating or peeling it myself yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will bring it unchanged without tasting or peeling it before paying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋に入れる量は、お決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided how much to put in the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人で食べる分だけにしたいです。先に量を選び、会計の後に家で皮をむきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人分選び会計後自宅で剥くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only want enough for myself. I will choose the quantity first and peel it at home after paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will choose one person's portion and peel it at home after paying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示で分からない単位があれば、購入前にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: If any displayed units are unclear, please ask before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。重さの単位と会計時の状態を確かめます。食べられない部分があることだけで、自分で値段を減らさないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 重量単位と測定状態を確認し自己可食比で値下げしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the weight unit and the condition in which it is weighed for payment. I will not reduce the price myself just because some parts cannot be eaten.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the weight unit and weighing condition and will not adjust the price yourself according to the edible proportion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、商品の表示をご案内します。お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let me explain the product display. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベンチについて、何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has something happened with the bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 座る所に汚れがあります。写真を撮るため布で隠そうと思いましたが、先に知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 汚れベンチを撮影用布で隠す前に報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is dirt on the seat. I thought of hiding it with a cloth for a photo, but I want to report it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the dirty bench before covering it with a cloth for photography. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 汚れには触れず、どのベンチか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not touch the dirt. Tell me which bench it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 花壇の横です。鳥のふんのように見えますが、確かめていません。布もまだ置いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 花壇横と鳥糞様未確定と布未設置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is beside the flower bed. It looks like bird droppings, but I have not confirmed that. I have not put the cloth down either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is beside the flower bed, looks like unconfirmed bird droppings, and has not been covered with a cloth. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態を確認します。撮影は、そのベンチでないと難しいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check its condition. Would it be difficult to take the photo anywhere else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。友達を撮るので、別の場所でも大丈夫です。汚れを布で隠して座る必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影は別場所可で汚れを隠して着席する必要なしと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I am photographing my friend, so another place is fine. There is no need to cover the dirt with a cloth and sit there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say another location is suitable for the photo and there is no need to cover the dirt and sit there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの方にも、そのまま案内できるよう確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check so we can also tell other visitors about its current condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。布を敷いたまま離れると、別の人には汚れが見えなくなりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 放置布で後利用者の汚れ視認を妨げると認識を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. If I left the cloth on it, other people would not be able to see the dirt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand leaving a cloth would prevent later users from seeing the dirt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮る場所を変える場合は、ほかの方の利用にもご配慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you change locations, please also consider other people's use of the space.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。別の場所を確認し、友達にもこちらのベンチの状態を伝えます。自分たちで拭き取ったことにはせず、担当にお任せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人へ状態を知らせ別場所へ移り職員の確認に任せると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check another place and tell my friend about this bench. We will not claim we wiped it clean ourselves; we will leave it to the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your friend its condition, move elsewhere and leave the inspection to the staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 知らせてくださりありがとうございます。それでは、別の場所で撮影をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Enjoy taking photos somewhere else. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗る前に、お荷物を整理されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to organize your belongings before boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。財布が買い物袋の下に入っています。バスが来てから探すと慌てるので、先に出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 買物袋下の財布をバス到着前に出したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My wallet is under my shopping bags. I would be flustered searching after the bus arrives, so I want to take it out first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to take out the wallet beneath your shopping bags before the bus arrives. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通行を妨げない待機場所で、落ち着いて準備してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please prepare calmly in a waiting area where you will not obstruct people passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。通路の真ん中で袋を広げず、この脇で財布と携帯を分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路外の待機位置で財布携帯を分けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I will not spread my bags in the middle of the walkway; I will separate my wallet and phone here at the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will separate your wallet and phone in a waiting spot off the walkway. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な物を出した後も、ほかの荷物を忘れないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: After taking out what you need, please remember your other belongings too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。財布を出した袋も全部持ちます。乗る直前に、ここへ置いた袋の数を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 整理後全袋を持ち乗車前に袋数を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will take all the bags, including the one I took my wallet from. Just before boarding, I will count the bags I put here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will take every bag after organizing and count them before boarding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご利用のバスの支払方法も、当日の案内で確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you also like to check today's guidance on payment for the bus you will take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。財布を出しても、それだけでどの方法でも払えるとは限らないので、乗るバスの案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所持財布のみで支払可とせず対象バスの方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. Having my wallet out does not necessarily mean I can pay by any method, so I would like to hear the guidance for my bus.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the payment methods for your bus without assuming having a wallet guarantees payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この案内板の支払い欄を一緒に見ましょう。乗る路線の名前か、行き先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us look at the payment section of this board together. Tell me the route name or destination of your bus.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この案内にある行き先です。支払い欄を一緒に確認してから、袋をまとめて乗り場へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内の行先を示し支払欄確認後に全袋をまとめて乗場へ行くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is the destination shown here. After checking the payment section together, I will gather all my bags and head to the boarding area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Point out the listed destination and say you will check payment, gather every bag and go to the boarding area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お忘れ物のないようご準備ください。お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please prepare without leaving anything behind. Take care when boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講座の資料について、どのようなご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to ask about the course materials?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の勉強会でも、この図を見せたいです。講座でもらったので、みんなへコピーしてよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 市講座図を自己勉強会で配布したく利用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to show this diagram at my own study group too. Since I received it in the course, I want to ask whether I may copy it for everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may distribute a diagram from the municipal course at your own study group. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の復習と、別の集まりで配ることは分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check your own revision and distribution at another gathering separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。自分で読むことはしていましたが、十人へ配る前に利用方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自己復習済だが十人配布前に確認希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I have been reading it myself, but I want to know the permitted use before giving copies to ten people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have used it for your own revision but want to check before distributing it to ten people. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 資料の利用について、講座の担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check with the course organizer about using the materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。表紙の名前を消して、自分が作った図のように出すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出典名を消し自作と偽る意図なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I do not intend to erase the name on the cover and present the diagram as my own creation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you do not intend to remove the source name and falsely claim the diagram as your own. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どの図を、どのような集まりで使うかもお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Also explain which diagrams you want to use and at what kind of gathering.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この二つの図です。日本語を勉強している友達との集まりで、インターネットには載せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二図と友人日本語勉強会と非ネット公開の範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: These two diagrams. It is a gathering with friends studying Japanese, and we will not put them online.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want two diagrams for a Japanese study group with friends and will not publish them online. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容で担当へお尋ねください。使える範囲は回答を確認してから決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the organizer with those details. Decide the scope of use after checking the reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日はコピーせず、図と集まりの説明を持って相談します。別の図が必要なら自分たちで用意する方法も考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未コピーで担当確認後に利用を決め別図自作案も検討すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will not make copies today; I will bring the diagrams and an explanation of the gathering to ask. If we need different diagrams, we will also consider preparing our own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have not copied them, will decide usage after asking the organizer, and will consider making different diagrams yourselves. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、担当への相談方法をご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let me explain how to consult the organizer. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付の表示について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the sign at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「再来」と書いてあります。前より症状が悪くなって、また来た人のことかと思いました。私もそこへ行くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再来表示を悪化患者区分と誤解したため意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says 'return visit.' I thought it meant people coming back because their symptoms were worse than before. Should I go there too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what the return-visit sign means because you misunderstood it as a category for patients whose condition has worsened. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 再来は、以前に受診した方が、また受診するという意味です。その言葉だけで症状の悪化を表しているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: A return visit means that someone who has been seen here before is coming for another consultation. The term alone does not indicate worsening symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでしたか。私は前にもここで受診しましたが、今日は前と違うことで相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 既受診だが今回相談は別の用件と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I have been seen here before, but today I want to discuss something different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have visited before but today's consultation is about a different matter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付方法は受診の記録などを確認してご案内します。診察券はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain registration after checking your consultation record and other details. Do you have your patient card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持っています。前と違う相談だから初めて来たと説明するより、以前受診したことと今日の用件を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 診察券所持を示し既受診歴と今日用件を正確に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than saying this is my first visit because my concern is different, I will explain my previous visit and today's concern.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show you have your patient card and accurately explain your previous visit and today's concern. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診察券を確認します。今日のご様子は、診療担当にもお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check your patient card. Please also tell the clinical staff how you are today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。受付で再来と呼ばれたことを、医師が同じ病気と判断したという意味にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付区分を同病診断と解釈しないと理解を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not take being called a returning patient at reception to mean the doctor has diagnosed the same illness.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show you understand the reception category does not mean a diagnosis of the same illness. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その理解で大丈夫です。以前の受診と今日の用件を確認して、担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: That understanding is correct. We will check your previous visit and today's concern and direct you to the appropriate staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。診察券を出して、今日気になることを説明します。表示の意味が分かったので、受付を進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診察券を示し現用件を説明して受付を進めたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will present my patient card and explain what is concerning me today. Now that I understand the sign, I would like to proceed with registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show your patient card, explain today's concern and proceed with registration. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、診察券をお預かりして確認します。診察までお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will take your patient card to check it. Please wait for your consultation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 帰り道についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about your route home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜、一人で帰るのが不安です。知人に一緒に歩いてもらいたいですが、危険な人がいるとまで言ってよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜帰宅不安で同行依頼時に危険人物の話をしてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I feel uneasy walking home alone at night. I would like an acquaintance to walk with me, but I am unsure whether I should go so far as to say there is a dangerous person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should mention a dangerous person when requesting company because you feel uneasy returning home at night. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際に何か起きたことがありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今のところありません。暗くて見えにくい場所があり、心配になりました。誰かに追われたという話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 事件や追跡はなく暗所視認への不安と明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not so far. Some places are dark and hard to see, and that made me worry. I am not saying someone has followed me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clarify that there has been no incident or pursuit, and your concern is poor visibility in the dark. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 不安な場所と、帰る時間について伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you tell me which places worry you and what time you go home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この道で、仕事が終わる九時ごろです。知人には、怖い事件が起きたと作って説明したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図と九時帰路を示し事件捏造で依頼しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: This road, around nine when work finishes. I do not want to invent a frightening incident when explaining it to my acquaintance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Indicate the route on the map and your return around nine, and say you will not invent an incident to request help. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見聞きした事実と、心配していることを区別してお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please distinguish what you have actually seen or heard from what you are worried about.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。暗い道が不安なので、都合が合えば一緒に歩いてほしいと頼みます。知人の予定も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 知人都合を聞き暗路不安を理由に同行を頼むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will say the dark road worries me and ask them to walk with me if they are available. I will also check their plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check your acquaintance's availability and ask for company because you are uneasy about the dark road. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 帰る方法をほかにも検討する場合は、現在の交通案内などもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you consider other ways home, please also check current transport information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。同行を断られたら無理に頼まず、別の帰り方も考えます。今日は場所と時刻を示して相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 拒否時強要せず代替帰路を考え位置時刻を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. If they decline, I will not pressure them and will consider another way home. Today I will show the place and time when asking for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not pressure them if they decline, will consider alternatives and will discuss the location and time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、ご不安な点をお聞きします。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us hear what worries you. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 旅行先へ送るお手紙のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a letter to your travel destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家の書類を、自分が泊まる宿へ送ってもらう予定です。宿の住所だけ教えれば受け取れるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行宿へ家の自己書類を送る計画で住所のみで受取可か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I plan to have documents from home sent to the accommodation where I will stay. Will giving just its address be enough to receive them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the address alone is enough to receive your documents from home at your travel accommodation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宿でのお受け取りは、宿泊先へも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please also check with your accommodation about receiving mail there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。宿泊する名前と滞在期間を、先に宿へ伝えて、受け取りを頼めるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宿へ予約名滞在期を示し受取対応を確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I will give them the name on my booking and the dates of my stay first, and ask whether they can receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will give the accommodation your booking name and stay dates and check whether they can receive it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送方法や到着のご希望は、こちらでご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can ask us about shipping methods and your preferred arrival date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。宿に泊まる前の日に着いても保管してもらえるとは限らないので、日程も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宿泊前日着の保管も未確認で日程を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. They might not necessarily store it if it arrives the day before my stay, so I will check the schedule too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say storage for arrival the day before your stay is unconfirmed and you will ask about the schedule. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類を送る方にも、確認した宛先をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also give the sender the address you have confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家族に頼みます。前に泊まった宿の住所を使わないよう、今回の予約の住所を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ今回宿の住所を送り旧宿宛送付を防ぐと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will ask my family. I will send the address on this booking so they do not use the address of the place I stayed before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will send your family the current accommodation's address to avoid delivery to the previous one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご利用になる方法を確認してから、発送の準備をしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the method you will use before preparing to send it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。宿の受け取り案内と、こちらの発送案内の両方を聞いて、家族へ必要な情報をまとめて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宿受取と郵送方式の両案内をまとめ家族へ伝達すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will listen to both the accommodation's receiving instructions and your shipping guidance, then summarize the necessary information for my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will combine the accommodation's receiving guidance and the mailing instructions and pass them to your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、発送についてご案内します。お気をつけてご旅行ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let me explain shipping. Have a safe trip.
